shortDescription: Manage snapshots of the running states of selected features.

options.name: action
options.description: Define what snapshot action the module would perform.

options.name: compare_option
options.description: Snapshot options to be used when C(action=compare).

options.name: comparison_results_file
options.description: Name of the file where snapshots comparison will be stored when C(action=compare).

options.name: description
options.description: Snapshot description to be used when C(action=create).

options.name: element_key1
options.description: Specify the tags used to distinguish among row entries, to be used when C(action=add).

options.name: element_key2
options.description: Specify the tags used to distinguish among row entries, to be used when C(action=add).

options.name: path
options.description: Specify the path of the file where new created snapshot or snapshots comparison will be stored, to be used when C(action=create) and C(save_snapshot_locally=true) or C(action=compare).

options.name: row_id
options.description: Specifies the tag of each row entry of the show command's XML output, to be used when C(action=add).

options.name: save_snapshot_locally
options.description: Specify to locally store a new created snapshot, to be used when C(action=create).

options.name: section
options.description: Used to name the show command output, to be used when C(action=add).

options.name: show_command
options.description: Specify a new show command, to be used when C(action=add).

options.name: snapshot1
options.description: First snapshot to be used when C(action=compare).

options.name: snapshot2
options.description: Second snapshot to be used when C(action=compare).

options.name: snapshot_name
options.description: Snapshot name, to be used when C(action=create) or C(action=delete).
